title: storytold/artcraft: an IDE for composing AI images and video
friendlyTitle: ArtCraft is an open studio for AI images and video
summary: ArtCraft is an open desktop workspace for composing AI images and video, with tools for placing characters, staging 3D scenes and choosing among image, video, audio and 3D models. It was the strongest new AI-related repository on today's GitHub trending list that this publication has not already covered, with about 3,172 stars today and roughly 27,600 overall.
friendlySummary: ArtCraft is a desktop tool for planning and making AI images and video. It gained about 3,172 stars today, the most of any new AI repository on today's trending list.
whyItMatters: Artists and filmmakers can use it to plan a shot before generating it, instead of relying on a single prompt. It connects to hosted models, so check which providers a project actually needs before treating a local install as fully offline.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can arrange a scene first, then generate the image or video. Some features still need outside model providers.
